name: My Zypps Cryo Half Ounce - Tropicana Cherry
description:
Infused and ready to roll. The My Zypps Tropicana Cherry half ounce delivers 14 grams of pre-ground flower, cryo-infused for extra potency and full flavor — no grinder needed, just scoop and go.

Tropicana Cherry brings a bright, fruit-forward profile: sweet dark cherry and zesty citrus up front with a smooth, subtly earthy finish.

14G pre-ground cryo-infused flower — half ounce, ready to roll straight from the bag
Cryo-infused — extra potency with a smooth, even burn
Signature Tropicana Cherry flavor — sweet cherry and zesty citrus with an earthy finish

My Zypps Tropicana Cherry is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
